name: beat
summary: A cover, logo, card or play button that pulses with the music of a page player: it scales, shakes and glows, or sends out rings, on the beat.
looks: While the <audio> or <video> plays, the element swells by zoom on every beat of the kick drum and settles back over duration, with a soft halo in color around its rounded shape, or a ring that travels outward from its edge for each beat. by bass follows the bass line instead of single beats, by level the loudness of any sound, such as a voice. The element itself stays live DOM: links and buttons work, text stays sharp. Paused, nothing moves and nothing draws.
target: any element near an <audio> or <video>: a cover image, a logo, a card or the play button; the player is the nearest one around it, or the one data-dio-for names

params.name: for
params.description: Selector of the audio or video; empty takes the first one in the closest container that holds one.

params.name: by
params.description: What drives the pulse: beat jumps on each kick drum, for music with a beat; bass follows the bass line smoothly, for slow or ambient music; level follows the loudness, for podcasts and talks.

params.name: style
params.description: glow lights a soft halo around the element that breathes with the pulse; ring sends a thin ring out from its edge on each beat, for round play buttons and avatars.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the halo and the rings, any CSS color.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Scale of the element at the top of a pulse, 1.06 grows it by 6 %; 1 or 0 keeps its size.

params.name: shake
params.description: How far the element jolts on a beat, in a new direction each time; 0 keeps it still.

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the halo and the rings; 0 draws nothing and leaves only zoom and shake.

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the halo reaches and the rings travel past the edge.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: How readily a rise in the bass counts as a beat; higher catches softer beats.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time a pulse takes to settle back.

params.name: fps
params.description: Frame cap while the music plays.

frames.note: None while the player is paused; at most fps while it plays, then until the last pulse and ring fade.

reducedMotion.note: No zoom, shake or rings: while the music plays the halo holds a steady soft light, and the sound is never analyzed.

presence.note: The halo fades with the page; the element itself leaves with the DOM.

touch: The same as with a mouse: the pulse follows the sound, not the pointer.

cost.gpu: One quad around the element drawn by a fragment shader, only while a pulse or a ring shows.
cost.memory: A few kilobytes of analyzer data.

examples.title: An album cover that swells on the kick drum
A round play button that sends out rings
A podcast cover that breathes with the voice

name: visualizer
summary: The sound of a page player made visible: live bars, a wave, a ring or a waveform.
looks: bars draws the spectrum on a log scale from 40 Hz to 16 kHz with a soft fall, wave the oscilloscope as a ribbon, ring the bars around a circle. peaks draws the waveform of the whole track from precomputed peaks, the played part in accent; a click or a drag seeks and hover shows the position. The <audio controls> stays the DOM: native controls, keyboard and media keys.
target: an empty decorative element next to an <audio> or <video>

params.name: for
params.description: Selector of the audio or video; empty takes the closest one before it.

params.name: style
params.description: bars, wave, ring, or peaks for a waveform of the whole track.

params.name: peaks
params.description: URL of the peaks JSON: audiowaveform v2 or an array of 0..1.

params.name: bars
params.description: Number of bars.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the bars, the wave and the unplayed part.

params.name: accent
params.description: Color of the played part and the position mark.

params.name: gap
params.description: Gap between bars as a share of a step.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius of the bars.

params.name: range
params.description: Analyzer range in decibels.

params.name: smooth
params.description: Smoothing of the analyzer over time.

params.name: mirror
params.description: Bars grow both ways from the middle.

params.name: seek
params.description: With peaks, a click, a tap or a drag seeks and hover shows the position; off, the waveform only shows progress, for a list where a click opens the episode.

params.name: fps
params.description: Frame cap while playing.

frames.note: None while paused; at most fps while playing, then a 0.3 s fall.

reducedMotion.note: bars, wave and ring hold a calm still shape; peaks works fully.

touch: A tap on peaks seeks; dragging needs touch-action: pan-y.

cost.gpu: One quad drawn by a fragment shader and a 128 x 1 data texture updated per frame.
cost.memory: A few kilobytes of analyzer data and peaks.
